title: Giant Kelp Grows Two Feet in One Day, an Inch Every Hour

scenes.text: Giant kelp grows two feet in a single day.
That's about an inch every hour.
It forms underwater forests off the coast of California.
It can reach a hundred feet long or more.
Gas-filled bladders hold its blades up toward the sunlight.
Sea otters rest in it, and fish hide in it. A whole ecosystem grows from one tiny spore.

description:
Giant kelp can grow about two feet a day, roughly an inch every hour, in ideal conditions.
It can reach 100 feet or more.
Could you watch it grow?
first_comment: Would you dive in a kelp forest or avoid it?
